description: Production Deploy Pipeline: a local deploy command with the OAuth logins of wrangler and convex (no GitHub secrets), an inventory check with one decision for each cloud resource, Convex deploy then Worker deploy then a smoke test with a Worker rollback, the math app and BM2 in production on workers.dev, deploy keys piped into wrangler secret put, the OpenRouter key through a secret card, a release rule after each closeout that changes an app, and the documents. Daniel authorized the orchestrator to deploy and to delete old cloud resources (2026-11-14). Depends on the track set unified-math-app_20261114 and bm2-convex-auth-v2_20261114.

sprint.goal: The math app and BM2 run in production on workers.dev from one local deploy command, with a smoke test and a rollback, and the documents describe this path.

stories.title: Deploy tooling and the math app in production
